title: SERVICES
description: Hacksoft provides fractional CTO leadership and the technical services behind it. We step in as your technology executive, assess what you have, set direction, build the team, and stay until it runs without us. Whether you're a startup that needs its first technology leader or an established company facing growth, a deal, or a turnaround, you get senior judgment at a fraction of the cost of a full-time hire.

servicesBoxes.desc: Part-time executive leadership for your technology organization. We set technology strategy, align it to your business plan, and guide budget and vendor decisions. We assess your team, architecture, and processes, then build the roadmap. For mergers and acquisitions, we provide technology due diligence and integration planning, backed by experience on both the buy and sell sides.

Database design, analytics, and reporting, plus practical AI adoption. We help you structure data you can trust, then apply AI where it pays off: automating workflows, surfacing insight, and informing decisions. That includes AI strategy for executive teams and boards.

Custom software built to last, from enterprise applications and integrations to customer-facing websites and apps with clear, responsive UX. Our depth in .NET, Azure, and SQL Server, along with JavaScript, Java, and Python, also covers AI-enabled tools. We write production code, and we review architecture and code quality for teams that already have developers.

Hands-on training and coaching that improves how your teams plan, ship, and respond to change. Led by certified practitioners (PMP, ACP, Certified Scrum Professional), with working sessions built around your actual projects.
